stages.title: Play the story
stages.summary: Play Chapters 1 through 5 in order while experiencing the narrative campaign of Leonida. Make sure to perform the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude while available, and keep manual saves at each chapter start and end because mission replay is absent. Cheats disable both trophies and saving progress.
trophy_names: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
stages.tip: Always maintain rotating manual saves at chapter boundaries.

stages.title: Robberies & wanted
stages.summary: Tackle bank vaults, armored transport trucks, gang operations, and partner store robberies across the map. Focus on losing high wanted levels and successfully laundering marked cash bills through safehouses.
stages.tip: Plan your escape routes before initiating bank vaults and store hold-ups.

stages.title: Races, ranges & stunts
stages.summary: Master stunt jumps across Leonida, earn gold medals at shooting ranges, win drone and street races, and complete side activity challenges.
stages.tip: Upgrade handling and braking on vehicles before tackling advanced stunt jumps.

stages.title: Collectibles & map
stages.summary: Collect playing card sets, scan WAiNK locations, explore all 52 distinct map regions, and register vehicles into your personal garages.
stages.tip: Use in-game radar markers and companion maps to track regional exploration.

stages.title: A Long Road — the 100% checklist
stages.summary: After completing the main story, open the pause menu under Progress, then Stats, and finally 100% Completion. Work methodically through 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 stunt jumps, 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, Target Decks, meditations, card sets, and WAiNK locations. Nothing on this tracker is missable, and prior stages feed directly into this completion requirement.
stages.tip: Check off activities systematically using the in-game progress tracker.

stages.title: Strangers & character quests
stages.summary: Complete all 8 stranger strands and character questlines featuring Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, and Bret, then mop up remaining open world activities.
stages.tip: Check map markers regularly between story acts for newly spawned stranger encounters.

stages.title: Cleanup & the unconfirmed
stages.summary: Finish any missed early achievements like Positive Mental Attitude, uncover hidden trophies with published methods, complete stat grinds, and address the two trophies awaiting fully confirmed community trigger methods.
stages.tip: Tackle the missable balcony meditation early in Chapter 1 to avoid a full replay.
